Person 0..2 adoptiveParents -- * adoptedChild Person
A Person called adoptedChild may have a Person called adoptiveParents. And there is an upper bound of at most 2 Persons called adoptiveParents.
A Person called adoptiveParents has some Persons called adoptedChild. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.
